# Known Issues

`~/.claude/KNOWN-ISSUES.md` is a private operational log, gitignored by design. Read it in full before a production deploy or when a failure resembles a prior incident.

If the file is absent, say so explicitly: it is gitignored, so a fresh clone never has it. Proceed without it and do not read the absence as "no known issues".
